evals.name: typical-request
evals.prompt: <A request the way a colleague would type it, with real details: names, numbers, a deadline.>
evals.expected_output: <What a good result looks like: file path, key content, what is NOT done, what the final message says.>
assertions: <A checkable statement, e.g. 'File created at docs/my-thing/<name>.md'>

evals.name: tricky-request
evals.prompt: <Missing information, a request the skill should refuse or push back on, or a status change.>
evals.expected_output: <What the skill should do instead of guessing.>
assertions: <'Asks for <missing fact> instead of inventing it'>
<'No file created' or 'Only the status changed, through the script'>
